text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: What am I gonna dooo!? Ahhh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the academy's dance event, 
Droit. Tap Dance City was fretting over 
something. To sum up what I heard...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow's finally the Droite! Ooh, you're 
joining right from the start, right? Let's 
dance our hearts out all day long~!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Companion
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, why the long face? Let me 
guess? Your French fries went soggy, 
right!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Companion
text_block_list.text:
That's not it. ...I just realized that 
once the Droit is over, I won't be able to 
make a ruckus with everyone like this 
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? Whoa, hey, that has nothing to do 
with this! You might be leaving the 
academy this spring—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Still, so what?! Once we've got a base, we 
can gather everyone up again in no time!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Companion
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, thanks. But you know—once you see 
less of each other, you never know what 
will happen to a friendship... right?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
~~gh, there's no way it ends like this! 
I'm not letting it end with a sad face 
like that!

"...Parting. That is to say, predestined 
fate."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
O passionate dancer. Whatever you may say, 
it does not change the fact that this is a 
farewell.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Gimlet...! I don't want something like—!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
However, you need not leave the taste of 
the fine farewell wine poured into your 
cup to the gods of destiny.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I shall pour it myself for my brethren 
gathered at the Round Table. A beloved, 
fragrant—fine wine of farewell.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...In other words, is this what you want 
to say? What kind of 'farewell' it will 
be...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...! Thanks, Gimlet! Trainer! Yeah, 
that's right!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Companion
text_block_list.text:
"...Droit is over too, huh. Fufu, it went 
by in a flash... ............"

text_block_list.name: Tap's Companion
text_block_list.text: ...? Did the music stop?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Let's set sail! Alright, crew! Prepare to 
set sail!"

text_block_list.name: Tap's Companion
text_block_list.text: W-Whaaat!? Tap!?!?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Aye, that I am—your captain! Which 
means—you've got no business making a face 
like that, right?"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
To all those aboard, welcome to our 
banquet! Let's wrap things up with a huge 
bang!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Venue
text_block_list.text:
—Huh, what? Why all of a sudden? —Wait, I 
don't even know the choreography for this 
song...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*tap-tatta-tap-tattan!*)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Venue
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, so good...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Why? What? Ha, because the louder the 
starting gun for setting sail, the 
better!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Come on now, gather round! Sing and make 
some noise! Isn't it jolly? Isn't it fun?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
So――c'mon, go with a smile! Your compass 
will always point toward this ruckus 
anyway!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Companion
text_block_list.text:
Tap... Tap, Tap! You really are... the 
best captain ever!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! As long as I'm around—this 
party's never gonna end!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Night. I met Tap Dance City on her way 
back from the club. It seems the plan went 
off without a hitch—
choice_data_list: Looks like you made some great memories.
Looks like you made some great memories.
Did you push yourself too hard?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Night. I met Tap Dance City on her way 
back from the club. It seems the plan went 
off without a hitch—
choice_data_list: Looks like you made some great memories.
Looks like you made some great memories.
Did you push yourself too hard?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Besides, I'm sure the invitation 
made it safely.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, to our future base of operations. 
The banquet isn't over—let's keep partying 
over there!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"An eternal paradise filled with endless 
laughter—that's our prize. And we're 
definitely gonna grab it!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you, Navigator. I'll leave 
chartin' the course to the treasure to 
you, alright?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Reckless? Well... yeah, I did get chewed 
out a little bit. It's just a scratch!
choice_data_list:
Well, if that's the case, that's fine, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Besides, what happened today gave 
me a crystal-clear picture of it.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Spending time with those guys at our 
future base. Of course you'll be there 
too, won't you?"
